items.title: Introducing AWS RTB Fabric Modules available through AWS Marketplace: AdTech partner intelligence, inline in the bid path
items.summary: Today, AWS RTB Fabric Modules launched into general availability to help AdTech companies and their partners enhance their real-time bidding (RTB) workloads with ad intelligence and decisioning capabilities. AWS RTB Fabric Modules from AdTech partners including Pixalate, WURFL by ScientiaMobile, and Picnic are now available through AWS Marketplace. Optimizing advertising revenue in real-time bidding starts […]
